Title: Vinod and the Family

Cast

1. Vinod - 36 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Anil - 34 years, friend
Look: moustache, checked shirt
3. Pallavi - 32 years, friend
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Kavita - 58 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez
5. Hema - 26 years, daughter
Look: pink kurta, a long plait

Places

1. The forest - tall trees, thick bushes
2. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The forest - Day

[Vinod stands in the forest. Kavita, Anil and Pallavi stand near him.]

Kavita: "Let's do something fun today."

[Vinod goes hunting and aims his bow at a deer.]

Vinod (excited): "Let's see."

[Vinod rides an elephant through the forest.]

Vinod: "Careful!"

Scene 2: The hospital ward - Day

[Vinod is asleep in bed in the ward. Kavita and Pallavi stand near him.]

Vinod: "Mom, look over here."

[After a long illness Vinod passes away in his hospital bed.]

Pallavi: "Rest in peace."
